proposal.diagnosis: Cart total only reads first item price instead of summing all items
assumptions: Standard cart reduction over item price and quantity
proposal.rationale: Sum all item prices multiplied by quantities

edits.newContent: total: () => get().items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0),
